title: Data Generation & Rollouts
summary: This module generates conversational data through automated model rollouts and self-chat experiments. It explores persona vector influence and gate discovery by simulating multi-turn interactions.

nodes.label: Generate Extraction Rollouts
nodes.title: Generate Extraction Rollouts
nodes.description: Initiates the generation of model responses (rollouts) for data extraction, bypassing any judging mechanism. It serves as a wrapper for a specific step in an evaluation pipeline.

nodes.label: Execute Evaluation Step C
nodes.title: Execute Evaluation Step C
nodes.description: Performs a specific step within a broader evaluation pipeline, which includes generating model rollouts. This component is part of the `experiment_runners` module.

nodes.label: Gemma LLM
nodes.title: Gemma Large Language Model
nodes.description: The external Gemma Large Language Model service, providing text generation capabilities for both rollouts and self-chat experiments.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Self-Chat Experiment
nodes.title: Orchestrate Self-Chat Experiment
nodes.description: Drives an experiment where a language model engages in multiple self-chat sessions. It configures persona vectors and gate mechanisms to observe their influence on conversational dynamics.

nodes.label: Load LLM & Tokenizer
nodes.title: Load LLM & Tokenizer
nodes.description: Initializes and loads the specified language model and its tokenizer, making them ready for text generation tasks. This component is from the `persona_activations` module.

nodes.label: Persona Configuration
nodes.title: Persona Configuration & Grid
nodes.description: Input data defining persona traits, vector configurations, and experimental grid parameters used to guide the self-chat sessions.

nodes.label: Run Single Self-Chat Session
nodes.title: Run Single Self-Chat Session
nodes.description: Executes one complete multi-turn self-chat conversation. It applies loaded persona vectors and gate states to influence the model's responses throughout the session.

nodes.label: Store JSON Transcript
nodes.title: JSON Conversation Transcript
nodes.description: Outputs a comprehensive JSON file containing the full transcript of all self-chat sessions, including messages, gate states, and session metadata.

nodes.label: Display Session Summary
nodes.title: Standard Output Display
nodes.description: Prints a human-readable summary of each self-chat session to the standard output, detailing turns, gate activations, and messages.

nodes.label: Rollout Output File
nodes.title: Rollout Output File
nodes.description: The designated file path where the generated data from the extraction rollouts is saved.

groups.label: Self-Chat Experiment Driver
groups.title: Self-Chat Experiment Driver
groups.description: The primary entry point for configuring and running the self-chat gate discovery experiment.

groups.label: Data Generation Engines
groups.title: Data Generation Engines
groups.description: Components responsible for actively generating new textual data or conversational interactions.

groups.label: Data Inputs/Outputs
groups.title: Data Inputs and Outputs
groups.description: Represents the configuration data consumed and the generated data produced by the module.
